noun.d: (legal terminology) the Latin word for wife
a husband who murders his wife
the murder of a wife by her husband
foolish fondness for or excessive submissiveness to one's wife

adjective.d: befitting or characteristic of a wife
foolishly fond of or submissive to your wife

adverb.d: in a loving and uxorious manner
e: he kept deferring uxoriously to Mary
